blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解目視檢查資格確認與驗證（Qualification & Validation）的整體框架，包括標準品（Standards）的設計與用途
blocks.en: Understand the overall framework for qualification & validation of visual inspection, including the design and purpose of standards

blocks.zh: 掌握缺陷標準品（Defect Standards）的製備要求：單顆粒子、粒子特性描述、照片文件
blocks.en: Understand the requirements for preparing defect standards: single particles, particle characterization and photographic documentation

blocks.zh: 了解三類粒子類型（玻璃、金屬、彈性體、塑膠、纖維）在訓練與確認中的角色
blocks.en: Understand the role of the particle types (glass, metal, elastomer, plastic, fiber) in training and qualification

blocks.zh: 熟練掌握拒絕概率（Rejection Probability, PoD）的確定方法，以及 Knapp 方法學的核心邏輯
blocks.en: Master the method for determining the Probability of Detection (PoD) and the core logic of the Knapp methodology

blocks.zh: 理解測試集（Test Sets）的設計原則：拒絕區、灰色區、驗收區的定義與應用
blocks.en: Understand the design principles of test sets: the definitions and use of the Reject Zone, Gray Zone and Accept Zone

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 檢查驗證的邏輯鏈
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Logic Chain of Inspection Validation

blocks.zh: 目視檢查的資格確認與驗證形成一個嚴密的邏輯鏈：
blocks.en: Qualification and validation of visual inspection form a tight logic chain:

blocks.zh: 定義缺陷類型（按風險分類）
blocks.en: Define the defect types (classified by risk)

blocks.zh: 製備缺陷標準品（單顆粒子、有特性描述）
blocks.en: Prepare defect standards (single particles, characterized)

blocks.zh: 重複手動檢查 30–50 次確定 PoD
blocks.en: Repeat manual inspection 30–50 times to determine the PoD

blocks.zh: 組裝測試集（含拒絕區、灰色區、驗收區）
blocks.en: Assemble the test set (including Reject Zone, Gray Zone and Accept Zone units)

blocks.zh: 用測試集資格確認檢查員 / 驗證 AVI 系統
blocks.en: Use the test set to qualify inspectors / validate the AVI system

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 為什麼只能用單顆粒子
blocks.en: Analogy: Why Only Single Particles

blocks.zh: 把標準品製備想成考試出題：如果一道題裡有三個錯誤（對應多顆粒子），答對率看起來很高，但你不知道受試者是否真的能發現每一個錯誤。
blocks.en: Think of preparing standards as setting an exam question: if a question contains three errors (corresponding to multiple particles), the correct-answer rate looks high, but you do not know whether the candidate could really find each error.

blocks.zh: 用單顆粒子的目的，正是確保我們能精確測量「偵測到這一顆特定大小/類型粒子的機率」，而不是用多顆粒子「稀釋」假陰性風險，讓數據看起來更好看。
blocks.en: The purpose of using single particles is precisely to ensure that we can accurately measure "the probability of detecting this one particle of a specific size/type", rather than using multiple particles to "dilute" the false-negative risk and make the data look better.

blocks.zh: 測試集中 10% 上限的缺陷品比例，也是同樣邏輯：如果一個測試集有 50% 是缺陷品，檢查員可能會養成「全部拒絕」的偏差策略，高估了系統的真實靈敏度。
blocks.en: The 10% cap on the proportion of defective units in a test set follows the same logic: if 50% of a test set were defective, inspectors might develop a biased "reject everything" strategy and overestimate the true sensitivity of the system.

blocks.zh: 公式 — Knapp 方法學的核心計算
blocks.en: Formula: Core Calculations of the Knapp Methodology

blocks.zh:
PoD 計算（每個標準品容器）：
  PoD = (拒絕次數) / (檢查次數)

建議重複次數：30–50 次（多名檢查員）
最低 PoD 門檻：70%（進入「拒絕區」）

三個區域定義：
  拒絕區 (Reject Zone)：PoD ≥ 70%
    → 測試集缺陷品必須來自此區

  灰色區 (Gray Zone)：30% ≤ PoD < 70%
    → 可選擇性納入，用於比較研究
    → 不作為資格確認的正式驗收標準

  驗收區 (Accept Zone)：PoD < 30%
    → 代表正常/合格品（空白容器）
    → 用於評估假拒率

RZE（拒絕區效率）：
  = 所有 PoD ≥ 70% 標準品的 PoD 平均值
  用於評估整體系統性能，而非單容器
blocks.en:
PoD calculation (for each standard container):
  PoD = (number of rejections) / (number of inspections)

Recommended number of repeats: 30–50 (multiple inspectors)
Minimum PoD threshold: 70% (enters the "Reject Zone")

Definition of the three zones:
  Reject Zone: PoD ≥ 70%
    → defective units in the test set must come from this zone

  Gray Zone: 30% ≤ PoD < 70%
    → optional inclusion, for comparative studies
    → not used as a formal acceptance criterion for qualification

  Accept Zone: PoD < 30%
    → represents normal/acceptable units (blank containers)
    → used to evaluate the false reject rate

RZE (Reject Zone Efficiency):
  = the mean PoD of all standards with PoD ≥ 70%
  used to evaluate overall system performance, not a single container

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 真實粒子 vs. 球形標準粒子
blocks.en: Key Point: Real Particles vs. Spherical Standard Particles

blocks.zh: USP 的立場非常清楚：生產環境中的真實缺陷樣品優於商業球形粒子標準品，原因在於：
blocks.en: The USP position is very clear: real defect samples from the production environment are preferable to commercial spherical particle standards, because:

blocks.zh: 真實粒子有不規則形狀 → 更真實反映生產中的偵測挑戰
blocks.en: Real particles have irregular shapes → they better reflect the detection challenges in production

blocks.zh: 真實粒子有真實的密度與折射率 → 移動行為更接近實際狀況
blocks.en: Real particles have real density and refractive index → their movement behavior is closer to actual conditions

blocks.zh: 球形粒子移動太規律 → 容易被機器偵測但不代表真實性能
blocks.en: Spherical particles move too regularly → easily detected by machines but not representative of real performance

blocks.zh: 球形標準粒子的合法用途：AVI 系統的日常校正（Routine Calibration），即每日運行前確認機器基本功能是否正常。但驗證和人員資格確認必須使用真實缺陷標準品。
blocks.en: The legitimate use of spherical standard particles: routine calibration of AVI systems, i.e., confirming basic machine function before each day's run. However, validation and personnel qualification must use real defect standards.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 測試集管理的常見陷阱
blocks.en: Practical Application: Common Pitfalls in Test Set Management

blocks.zh: 測試集（Test Set）是目視檢查系統的「金標準」，但管理不當會導致整個資格確認體系崩潰：
blocks.en: The test set is the "gold standard" of a visual inspection system, but poor management can bring down the entire qualification system:

blocks.zh: 粒子脫落：標準品使用前後必須用立體顯微鏡確認粒子存在 → 若找不到粒子，該次數據無效
blocks.en: Particle loss: the presence of the particle in the standard must be confirmed with a stereomicroscope before and after use → if the particle cannot be found, the data from that run are invalid

blocks.zh: 標準品老化：玻璃容器可能隨時間輕微腐蝕，影響粒子的移動行為 → 需設定重新確認週期
blocks.en: Aging of standards: glass containers may corrode slightly over time, affecting particle movement behavior → a requalification interval needs to be set

blocks.zh: 凍乾品標準品退化：每次使用都會磨損凍乾餅外觀 → 比液態產品更難維護，需頻繁替換
blocks.en: Degradation of lyophilized standards: every use wears the appearance of the cake → harder to maintain than liquid products and need frequent replacement

blocks.zh: 重複使用偏差：若同一組測試集被同一批人使用太多次，可能因記憶而提高通過率 → 定期更換容器順序或進行盲測
blocks.en: Repeated-use bias: if the same test set is used too many times by the same people, memory may inflate pass rates → change the container order periodically or use blind testing

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你正在為一個新的單株抗體產品建立目視檢查測試集。在製備標準品時，應優先考慮哪些粒子類型？如何決定目標粒子大小範圍（100 µm? 200 µm? 500 µm?）？
blocks.en: You are building a visual inspection test set for a new monoclonal antibody product. Which particle types should you prioritize when preparing the standards? How do you decide the target particle size range (100 µm? 200 µm? 500 µm?)?

blocks.zh: 如果一個標準品在 40 次重複檢查後 PoD = 68%，這個容器應被分類為哪個區？可以用於資格確認測試集的缺陷品嗎？
blocks.en: If a standard has a PoD of 68% after 40 repeat inspections, which zone should this container be classified into? Can it be used as a defective unit in a qualification test set?

blocks.zh: 為什麼測試集中缺陷品比例不應超過 10%？這個限制是否也適用於 AVI 系統的驗證測試？
blocks.en: Why should the proportion of defective units in a test set not exceed 10%? Does this limit also apply to validation testing of an AVI system?

blocks.zh: 7.6 Types of Test Sets — 測試集類型
blocks.en: 7.6 Types of Test Sets

blocks.zh: 公式 — 閾值曲線與 RZE 計算
blocks.en: Formula: Threshold Curve and RZE Calculation

blocks.zh:
閾值研究（Threshold Study）建立標準曲線：
  X 軸：粒子大小（µm）
  Y 軸：PoD（%）
  目標：確認 PoD ≥ 70% 所需的最小粒子大小

典型結果（清澈 10-mL 玻璃瓶，2000–3000 lux）：
  玻璃/不鏽鋼粒子：150–250 µm → 70% PoD
  纖維：500–2000 µm → 70% PoD

RZE 計算示例：
假設測試集有 5 個缺陷品，PoD 分別為：
  粒子 A：85%（拒絕區 ✓）
  粒子 B：75%（拒絕區 ✓）
  粒子 C：70%（拒絕區 ✓ 邊緣）
  粒子 D：55%（灰色區，不計入 RZE）
  粒子 E：25%（驗收區，不計入 RZE）

RZE = (85% + 75% + 70%) / 3 = 76.7%

初始資格確認：檢查員的 RZE 必須 ≥ 76.7%
blocks.en:
A threshold study establishes the standard curve:
  X axis: particle size (µm)
  Y axis: PoD (%)
  Goal: confirm the minimum particle size required for PoD ≥ 70%

Typical results (clear 10-mL glass vial, 2000–3000 lux):
  Glass/stainless steel particles: 150–250 µm → 70% PoD
  Fibers: 500–2000 µm → 70% PoD

RZE calculation example:
Assume the test set has 5 defective units with PoDs of:
  Particle A: 85% (Reject Zone ✓)
  Particle B: 75% (Reject Zone ✓)
  Particle C: 70% (Reject Zone ✓ borderline)
  Particle D: 55% (Gray Zone, not counted in RZE)
  Particle E: 25% (Accept Zone, not counted in RZE)

RZE = (85% + 75% + 70%) / 3 = 76.7%

Initial qualification: the inspector's RZE must be ≥ 76.7%

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 人員資格確認如同駕照考試
blocks.en: Analogy: Personnel Qualification Is Like a Driving Test

blocks.zh: 把目視檢查員的資格確認流程想成駕照考試制度：
blocks.en: Think of the qualification process for visual inspectors as a driver's license system:

blocks.zh: 視力測試前置條件 = 駕照體檢（視力、辨色力）
blocks.en: Vision test prerequisite = the medical check for a license (visual acuity, color discrimination)

blocks.zh: 筆試/照片訓練 = 駕駛法規筆試
blocks.en: Written test/photo training = the written traffic-law exam

blocks.zh: 3 次成功測試集檢查 = 路考（需多次通過才能領牌）
blocks.en: 3 successful test set inspections = the road test (several passes are needed to get the license)

blocks.zh: 年度再確認 = 定期換照（確認能力未退化）
blocks.en: Annual requalification = periodic license renewal (confirming that ability has not degraded)

blocks.zh: 離開 3 個月需重新確認 = 長期未開車需重新考試
blocks.en: Requalification after an absence of 3 months = retaking the test after a long period without driving

blocks.zh: 假拒率 <5% = 不能到處亂按喇叭（避免過度謹慎導致系統癱瘓）
blocks.en: False reject rate <5% = not honking the horn at everything (avoiding over-caution that paralyzes the system)

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 盲測（Blinding）的必要性
blocks.en: Key Point: The Need for Blinding

blocks.zh: 測試集使用 UV 墨水或條碼標記，而非一般標籤，原因是：
blocks.en: Test sets are marked with UV ink or barcodes rather than ordinary labels, because:

blocks.zh: 如果檢查員知道哪些是缺陷品，資格確認就失去意義
blocks.en: If inspectors know which units are defective, the qualification is meaningless

blocks.zh: 記憶效應（Memory Effect）：同一組測試集重複使用，檢查員開始「記住」哪瓶有問題
blocks.en: Memory effect: when the same test set is used repeatedly, inspectors begin to "remember" which vial has the problem

blocks.zh: 解決方案：定期更換測試集，或隨機化容器呈現順序
blocks.en: Solution: change test sets periodically, or randomize the order in which containers are presented

blocks.zh: 對 AVI 系統同樣適用：驗證時的測試集必須與「訓練」AVI 的樣品組完全分開——否則機器只是「記住了答案」，而非真正具備偵測能力。
blocks.en: The same applies to AVI systems: the test set used for validation must be completely separate from the sample set used to "train" the AVI, otherwise the machine has simply "memorized the answers" rather than truly having detection capability.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 括弧法（Bracketing Approach）的應用
blocks.en: Key Point: Application of the Bracketing Approach

blocks.zh: 為每一種產品/容器組合做完整的資格確認，對 CDMO 而言不切實際（可能有數十種產品）。括弧法是 FDA 和 USP 認可的科學化替代方案：
blocks.en: Performing a full qualification for every product/container combination is impractical for a CDMO (there may be dozens of products). Bracketing is a scientific alternative accepted by the FDA and USP:

blocks.zh: 選擇「最難偵測」和「最易偵測」的兩種組合做完整資格確認
blocks.en: Select the "hardest to detect" and "easiest to detect" combinations for full qualification

blocks.zh: 介於兩者之間的產品，透過科學理由認定「已被覆蓋」
blocks.en: Products falling between the two are considered "covered" on the basis of a scientific justification

blocks.zh: 括弧的維度可以是：容器大小、玻璃顏色、溶液黏度、劑型等
blocks.en: Bracketing dimensions can include container size, glass color, solution viscosity, dosage form, etc.

blocks.zh: 建立括弧矩陣前，需要先做風險評估，確認選擇的括弧端點確實代表了最惡劣的檢查條件。
blocks.en: Before establishing a bracketing matrix, a risk assessment is needed to confirm that the chosen bracketing endpoints truly represent the worst-case inspection conditions.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 有一名資深目視檢查員，她已擔任此職務 5 年，從未有過再確認失敗記錄。她去年度假 4 個月，回來後應如何處理她的資格狀態？
blocks.en: Your CDMO has a senior visual inspector who has held this role for 5 years and has never had a failed requalification record. She took a 4-month vacation last year. How should her qualification status be handled when she returns?

blocks.zh: 用 RZE 方法評估一名新檢查員：測試集的 3 個「拒絕區」標準品的 PoD 分別為 73%, 80%, 90%（閾值研究結果）。這名新員工在初始資格確認中，這 3 個容器分別被拒絕了 70%, 75%, 80% 的次數。他通過了嗎？
blocks.en: Use the RZE method to evaluate a new inspector: the 3 Reject Zone standards in the test set have PoDs of 73%, 80% and 90% (threshold study results). In the initial qualification, this new employee rejected these 3 containers 70%, 75% and 80% of the time, respectively. Did he pass?

blocks.zh: 為什麼容器和閉合系統缺陷（如裂縫、密封不完整）也需要使用 Knapp 方法論來確定 PoD？僅靠目視評估「能看到/看不到」是否足夠？
blocks.en: Why do container closure defects (such as cracks and incomplete seals) also need the Knapp methodology to determine PoD? Is a visual assessment of "can see/cannot see" alone sufficient?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 兩種資格確認方法的比較
blocks.en: Core Concept: Comparison of the Two Qualification Methods

blocks.zh: CDMO 可以在驗證計畫中選擇其中一種，但必須事先書面確認並持續使用，不能在評估期間更換方法。
blocks.en: A CDMO may choose either one in its validation plan, but it must be confirmed in writing in advance and used consistently; the method cannot be changed during the evaluation period.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 的人員資格確認計畫設計
blocks.en: Practical Application: Designing a CDMO Personnel Qualification Program

blocks.zh: 一個完整的目視檢查員資格確認計畫應涵蓋：
blocks.en: A complete visual inspector qualification program should cover:

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Knapp 方法學是 USP 目視檢查驗證的黃金標準：30–50 次重複盲測確定 PoD，PoD ≥70% 才能進入拒絕區，構成測試集的缺陷品
blocks.en: The Knapp methodology is the gold standard for USP visual inspection validation: 30–50 blinded repeats determine the PoD, and only a PoD ≥70% enters the Reject Zone and can be used for defective units in the test set

blocks.zh: 測試集設計關鍵：單顆粒子（避免 PoD 虛高）、缺陷品 ≤10%（避免拒絕偏差）、使用前後驗證粒子存在、有重複備份單元
blocks.en: Key points of test set design: single particles (to avoid an inflated PoD), defective units ≤10% (to avoid rejection bias), verification of particle presence before and after use, and duplicate backup units

blocks.zh: 人員資格確認：初始需 3 次通過；年度再確認需 1 次；離開 >3 個月需重新確認；假拒率需 <5%
blocks.en: Personnel qualification: 3 passes initially; 1 pass for annual requalification; requalification after an absence of >3 months; false reject rate <5%

blocks.zh: RZE（拒絕區效率）是比單純「回收率」更精確的系統性能指標，適用於 AVI 驗證和複雜產品的人員確認
blocks.en: RZE (Reject Zone Efficiency) is a more precise system performance metric than a simple "recovery rate", and is suitable for AVI validation and for personnel qualification on complex products

blocks.zh: 括弧法允許科學化減少每個產品的完整資格確認需求，但前提是適當的風險評估和書面理由
blocks.en: Bracketing allows a scientific reduction in the need for full qualification of every product, provided there is an appropriate risk assessment and a written justification
